scope: Fixed named O3/direct Shell/controller/settings/scene/provenance sources and their named .gd UID sidecars only; no recursive dependency/global UID/bank census or full-project archive.
engine_started_scope: Canonical run_validation launches internally; actual start is unconfirmed until it returns. An exception may occur before or after Popen; do not infer no child.
return_code_scope: Canonical dev returned after owned child wait/cleanup. Nonzero may represent timeout/script-error detection; no separate raw child exit status is exposed.

raw_diagnostics.scope: Retained raw host/runtime text only. Zero validation is not a blanket diagnostic-clean claim; Root classifies original diagnostics.
